== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Astromech Shortage (Japanese)|Astromech Shortage]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 164793252.

Crop rectangle <code>(256, 1140, 2334, 4046)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4951f11b185c0f43acd5ab56316a4410499a570283702097ffa9ad0c1fd557d7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
